purpose: 1170 published GPU baseline offline checks and verification of restored graphics inputs

baseline.name: Normalized GPU baseline, complete 720p 1170
baseline.deployment_state: Historical 1170 acceptance, with exact frozen graphics inputs.

checks.name: rsi-boundary
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual dispatcher/copy/IPA helpers and endpoint core with synthetic REC/S2/device state; not physical GPC or Linux concurrency

checks.name: private-bind
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual Client VM_BIND control flow with kernel/DRM/RPC doubles, including middle-range unmap, failed-UNMAP retry, adjacent-node replacement, hole remap, BO/VM close retention, stale zero-reference rejection, owner-transfer reconciliation, bounded work backlogs, preallocation failure, and pending BO/VM references; not actual PTE state, device access, or physical memory pressure

checks.name: private-metadata
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual native private GPUVA callbacks with MMIO/page-table doubles; no hardware execution

checks.name: task-bridge
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual task owner/RPC source with kernel/transport/RSI doubles; all Proxy handlers are audited for zero-initialized whole-size replies, pattern-initialized RMM_TASK bytes are checked across error/success paths, VM_SYNC replay idempotence and stale version denial are model/control-flow only; no real firmware, DRM scheduling, DEV_QUERY data semantics, or session-transport recreation

checks.name: private-submit
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual submit planner with host doubles; not real RSI, Linux concurrency or GPU execution

checks.name: bo-cache
checks.evidence_boundary: Cache functions with lock/memory/RSI model; not proof of Linux race freedom

checks.name: gem-lifecycle
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual private/shared Panthor GEM publication functions with DRM handle/reference doubles; initialization precedes publication, handle-create and share failures clean up exactly once, successful creation drops its local reference, immediate close releases the handle, and diagnostic lookup holds a live reference; no real IDR/debugfs/Linux concurrency

checks.name: stream-status
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual firmware status load against incoherent device double; real GPU timing needs L3

checks.name: complete-fault-window
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual firmware/platform core with modeled post-snapshot completion/fault mutations across 15 cases and two Clients; RMM task observation summaries retain the first failure, reject reobservation after failure without MMIO, and bind the task token. Skipping the post-read check, forgetting the first failure or reobserving a failed task aborts. Counts represent software observations, not physical IRQ or successful STATUS ACK counts. No physical IRQ, W1C timing, GPU execution, Linux concurrency, or L3 device isolation is claimed

checks.name: completion-authority
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual firmware/platform core over completion scenarios 66-93, including absent/stale STATUS ACK, forged queue/consumer/counter/error fields, faults, and return failures; deleting pending-authority validation aborts. Device writes and physical GPU Stage-1 behavior remain modeled

checks.name: xshm-event-order
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual xshm endpoint pending/acknowledged/arm state machine; duplicate notifications coalesce while pending count is retained, early events before ARM remain pending without a wake, post-ARM events wake once, stale ACK/ARM and nonparticipant operations are rejected, and query/rearm interleaving is repeated. Bounded endpoint, channel, trusted-history, and trusted-IRQ-log pools fail closed without overwriting identities or unconsumed records; history loss cannot be treated as successful FINISH. A trusted IRQ ring driven by actual notification sequences permits only consumed-slot wraparound and rejects forged tail/head, duplicate consumption, owner changes, unrecorded CPU migration, and overwrite of unconsumed records; no one-to-one IRQ/JOB mapping is assumed and no FINISH authority, fence, physical IRQ source/storage, GIC delivery, GPU execution, or unbounded physical log storage is claimed

checks.name: queue-history
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual in-RMM queue cursor helper with lease double; no GROUP_CREATE transport or real firmware

checks.name: group-bridge
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual Guest group bridge and Proxy reservation paths with host doubles; authoritative queue substitution/count rejection, quarantine retention, high-priority denial, and queue-priority non-upgrade are model/control-flow evidence. For X04 this covers only rejection of the highest requested group priority and non-upgrade of queue priority, not resource-pressure victim selection, fairness, latency, Linux concurrency, or hardware

checks.name: rmm-service
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual native service init/query functions with host RSI/MMIO doubles; forged capability/group/stream bounds and service handoff ordering, not physical FW boot or GPU slots

checks.name: firmware-config
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual firmware upload/seal/discovery/config helpers with synthetic MCU boot model and pinned CSF metadata; covers ordered legal upload, private snapshot, digest/section tamper rejection, advertised stream upper bound, immutable two-queue configuration, read-only Client rings, admission-owned CALL wrappers, cached FW properties, per-Client task/group quotas, global arena capacity, active-root/typed-cleanup retention, and install/boot/config failures retained in quarantine without publication or arbitrary control access. For X04 the modeled quota/arena-full failures deny A while another Client retains its active extent; no physical MMIO/MCU boot, GPU execution, physical takeover/DMA drain, physical resource pressure, fair scheduling, or victim latency is claimed

checks.name: gpu-command-permission
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual RMM firmware task-stage admission over a mapped Client stream, plus all 256 opcode values compared with the pinned Mesa 25.0.7 v10 enum. Legitimate FINISH_TILING (9) is accepted; undefined 19/35 and synthetic privileged markers are rejected. Three classifier mutants and a pre-admission gate exercise the oracle. Opcode classification does not prove operands, indirect streams, post-admission mutation or hardware privilege isolation; no physical GPU execution is claimed by this offline check

checks.name: firmware-parser
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual authenticated-image section parser with direct malicious metadata mutants; no digest approval or physical MMIO

checks.name: map-transaction-rsi
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual mapping-transaction RSI dispatch/core with host adapters; no real RTT concurrency or device TLB

checks.name: rsi-memory-chain
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual RSI/endpoint/snapshot/RTT/private-PT chain with host primitives; includes read-only BO authorization/service-map/PTE and second-GPUVA permission-oracle checks; no shader/GPC/TLBI/concurrent REC

checks.name: rsi-memory-chain-lifecycle
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual RMI destroy policy plus endpoint/private-authority invalidation and recycled-RD generation; old pending IRQ/channel authority is released, a recycled RD receives a fresh endpoint generation, old channels remain invalid, and a fresh RD cannot inspect old Client BOs; takeover therefore cannot inherit the previous queue/notification authority. RD reallocation, REC/RTT, smc_realm_create, persistent Proxy session state, transport reconnection, and physical DMA drain are modeled

checks.name: task-recovery
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual two-Client task failure, exact two-queue member/queue progress before and after OOM recovery, tiler-OOM event with pending FINISH, native-ENOMEM recovery then fresh complete-state progress, post-snapshot stream fault quarantine surviving fault-bit clear and FINISH/RETURN/RETIRE replay, running-task clock/power/S2-MMIO reconfiguration rejection, trusted and failed reset retention, backing release, reset completion without old-task SUCCESS/publication/CPU return, stale firmware/root authority after reset, hint-free FINISH polling, cross-owner FINISH-token rejection with independent second-Client FINISH success, collusive Proxy late-hint injection and A-token replay with B limited to fresh own state, replacement-task chain, trusted teardown before same-physical-page/table-slot reuse with fresh opaque generations and old dispatch/FINISH/service-map denial, and stale session token/context/service-map denial against the fresh owner. For X03, every task-chain scenario also applies a compromised Proxy's authorized group metadata plus dispatch replay, cross-owner completion/return/retire, service map/unmap, native control reset, malformed Host reset, and raw MMIO reinstall against both running Clients, with no extra device write/cache/flush, no CPU return, unchanged Client bytes, and no raw Proxy control. For X04 A failure, a Proxy late hint, or an A token cannot forge B success and B can progress only from fresh own state; firmware/MMIO/cache/device execution, physical IRQ delivery, GIC ownership, physical device-slot reuse, physical resource pressure, other-device DMA, and physical DMA drain remain models

checks.name: flush-recovery
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual RK3588 reset sequence with modeled ACK/timer: persistent soft-reset ACK loss performs exactly one bounded hard fallback, double-ACK loss remains false, and a final barrier is required; physical timing, IRQ state, DMA stop, and old-task resource release remain outside this checker

checks.name: memory-ops
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual private memory callbacks/core/RTT with modeled cache/granules and physical probes

checks.name: private-heap
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual heap lifecycle/growth linked to the RMM PT/ref core; a corrupted non-leaf root descriptor and a descriptor aliasing another context root fail closed without changing mapping epoch or cleanup state. BO/page-table allocation, growth, VA, heap-count, transport, and OOM failures retain only owner-attributed references and fail without borrowing a foreign object; preexisting foreign mappings and their pending references survive failed heap cleanup. For X04 this covers modeled allocation/OOM/transport failure isolation, not physical CPU, GPU, DMA, page-table writes, Linux memory pressure, fairness, or victim latency

checks.name: private-reclaim
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual dead-owner cleanup/PM dispatch and Host reclaim helper with lifecycle doubles. Stopped/NEW RD, reset failure, clear failure, restore/TLB-model failure, control detach, unexpected transport success, and perpetual INCOMPLETE leave busy owner/range references isolated; successful bounded retry retires old service pointers and rejects reuse through the same RD, preserving an owner-attributed retention ledger across delayed work and device failures. For X04 denied or failed A recovery retains B busy ranges/references and PTEs while B remains independently reclaimable; RD/RTT restoration, physical reset, physical memory pressure, fairness, and victim latency are models or not claimed

checks.name: domain-quantum
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual RSI/core/platform legal two-client task interleaving and bounded domain selection; does not cover stop/UNMAP BO reuse, physical GPU execution, IRQ timing, Linux concurrency, or reset

checks.name: replay-input
checks.evidence_boundary: Current START replay inputs through actual firmware/backend; no real device execution or response-loss transport

checks.name: cache-set
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual core differential paths with AS/cache models and rejected mutants; no real device cache or concurrency

checks.name: control-cache
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual control-read/cache-line synchronization callbacks; slot/granule and noncoherent memory are modeled

checks.name: live-summary
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual warm-summary core with mutant rejection; cache/RSI behavior remains modeled

checks.name: running-check
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual combined running-AS checks in GPU cores/platform; device adapters remain modeled

checks.name: mmio-mediation
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual service ownership/mediation and exact full-window MMIO alias policy with revoke-before-reset; bypassing owner/mediated state or partial-overlap aliases aborts. Physical CPU/DMA access, mixed pages, real Proxy, Linux concurrency, and L3 isolation are modeled

checks.name: rmi-dispatch
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual RMI dispatcher/table/policy with checked host concurrency; no real RD creation, GPU or GPC

checks.name: unpublished-prepare
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual RSI/core/platform unpublished-ring preparation; ring producer writes occur only after idle anchor and queue metadata validation; partial producer publication, producer root change, and read fault retain task/backing references while cancel/yield/group/BO destroy are rejected, with negative mutants and failure injection model-level

checks.name: xshm-memory-boundary
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual xshm memory/endpoint/service cores with existing host doubles; no shared-queue race or real REC

checks.name: service-binding
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual GPU service core and complete endpoint core with a dedicated fixture; production claim, XSHM unregister, RD destroy, and private-path adapter wiring is source-audited. Registered nonzero endpoint instance, owner binding, running/isolated generation checks, fail-closed invalidation, same-RD fresh-instance ID, stale-channel rejection, and endpoint-ID non-reuse are covered. Synthetic trusted reset callbacks and same-address RD model; no full RMM link, Proxy image measurement, remote attestation, approved-role provisioning, Linux concurrency, physical IRQ/DMA, or L3 hardware isolation is claimed

checks.name: proxy-role-attestation
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual RMM-private GPU role claim encoding/clear core; RSI claim writes the endpoint-bound claim into reserved REM slot 4 after service acceptance, XSHM unregister/RD destroy clears it, Guest RSI_MEASUREMENT_EXTEND cannot write the slot, and the standard Realm token REM array source includes it. No full RMM link, signed token execution, Proxy image/RIM approval policy, Client verifier, role provisioning, Linux concurrency, physical IRQ/DMA, or L3 isolation is claimed

checks.name: client-role-token-verifier
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual offline Client verifier executes ES384 COSE_Sign1 signature validation, exact challenge/RIM/profile/hash policy checks, and endpoint-derived REM slot 4 comparison with six fail-closed negatives. It uses a test trust anchor and synthetic delegated token; no platform certificate chain, trusted anchor/RIM provisioning, full TSM report execution, vmshm token transport, Linux concurrency, or L3 validation is claimed

checks.name: xshm-queue-integrity
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual Client vmshm queue send/receive validators over a synthetic untrusted window; no concurrent peer, IRQ, or physical vmshm

checks.name: input-identity
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual RSI input copy, IPA translation, and endpoint identity policy with synthetic REC/S2 state; no GPU workload, physical GPC, or Linux concurrency

checks.name: xshm-reply-replay
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual Client response dispatcher and sequence-allocator call path; controlled receive double exposes stale/duplicate matching and any missing sequence-zero wrap policy

checks.name: rpc-late-waiter
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual Client RPC call and response dispatcher with deterministic dispatcher-first/timeout-first interleavings; host completion, jiffies and receive doubles only, not real Linux waitqueue/workqueue concurrency

checks.name: late-device-access
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual GPU release/control and lease cores with a delayed-transaction double; failed revoke/reset retains the old lease and only successful reset drains before release/new-owner reuse. No physical GPC/IOMMU/TLBI timing

checks.name: control-residue
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual private GPU core control-memory path; donated firmware backing is cleared before mapped publication and repeated acquisition is denied. GPU local memory, scratch, registers and hardware caches remain unverified

checks.name: diagnostic-content
checks.evidence_boundary: Static audit of the actual Proxy scheduler fault diagnostic; raw Client instruction/syncobj/ring words are rejected and only bounded non-content summaries are allowed. No complete output inventory or board serial-capture proof

checks.name: mmio-vma
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual realm_gpu_bo_mmap and panthor_client_mmap_flush_id with host VMA/page doubles; control/resident backing is denied, MAP_PRIVATE and executable BO mappings are rejected, BO VM_MAYEXEC is cleared, read-only flush-id VM_MAYWRITE is cleared and VM_DONTCOPY is set, and Linux mprotect/fork policy is modeled from those VMA flags. No real Linux mmap/mprotect/fork syscall, concurrent VMA split/merge, RTT install, physical MMIO write, SMMU/DMA request, mixed-page alias, or L3 hardware isolation

checks.name: debug-disclosure
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual native Panthor show_each_vm/show_vm_gpuvas and DRM drm_debugfs_gpuva_info with a controlled seq_file and two synthetic Client VMs; the checker executes candidate and pointer-sanitized control variants, verifies frozen Client/Proxy configs enable unrestricted debugfs, and treats raw drm_gem_object addresses as outside the necessary service metadata allowed by the threat model. No real debugfs mount permission, performance counter, trace, coredump, FW debug/readback, physical timing side channel, or L3 hardware execution

checks.name: proxy-session-budget
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual Proxy session admission, rollback, lookup, close and OPEN_SESSION reply-failure paths with pthread locks and native DRM/channel doubles. Covers 64 global and 8 per-Client pending/retained sessions, 32 concurrent creators, cross-owner denial, final-reference accounting and permanent ID exhaustion. No actual Linux workqueue, board execution or whole-service fairness claim.

checks.name: rpc-work-budget
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual Proxy vmshm queue send/receive, request dispatch, drain, and rx-work functions with a host producer double. Legal maximal requests can sustain more than one queue capacity inside one work invocation, while direct counters cover request count, stack allocations, lock visits/intervals, slot retention, empty wakeups, payload validation, and victim latency. No real Linux workqueue scheduling, handler service cost, concurrent process timing, physical IRQ, fairness SLO, or L3 execution is claimed

checks.name: proxy-handler-dispatch
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual Proxy find/rx dispatch functions over every registered request handler; short/long payload and response-direction type are rejected before callback, while exact-size request reaches the handler. Per-handler field semantics and real transport remain separate

checks.name: proxy-worker-fairness
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual Proxy IRQ worker with modelled sessions/xarray/RMM events; Group round-robin visits all 12 Groups within two budget-8 rounds and the reset-cursor mutant starves high IDs. No real Linux workqueue or board timing

checks.name: fw-worker-teardown
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual native Panthor device/scheduler/FW unplug and reset-work functions with modeled Linux workqueue cancellation. Captures unplug before callback teardown, scheduler tick and PM reference drain, FW watchdog drain, IRQ suspend, FW stop/resource teardown, MMU/GPU unplug, post-unplug reset-work denial through drm_dev_enter, synchronous reset-work drain, and reset-workqueue destruction last. No real Linux workqueue concurrency, IRQ injection, hotplug bus teardown, Realm exit, physical device revocation, KASAN, fence callback execution, or L3 hardware timing

checks.name: gpu-irq-security
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual shared Monitor producer, RMM consumer and RMM mailbox bridge plus the actual firmware IRQ-claim fresh-evidence gate. Models capture identity/epoch, ordered offered ACK, fault latching, old-binding/slot reuse, progress coalescing, bounded overflow and Proxy statement rejection. Seven compiled mutants are rejected. Transport/cache/GIC and physical IRQ delivery are doubles here; actual Realm/EL3 integration and physical delivery counters are separate lab-run evidence, not inherited from this offline result.

checks.name: rmm-private-aggregate
checks.evidence_boundary: Full offline regression gate for core mapping/FW/control/revocation; not an attack-coverage or cross-tenant security proof

checks.name: control-cpu-views
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual persistent RMM CPU view/platform helpers; two-CPU TLB/cache/physical data/locks are models, not physical isolation

checks.name: control-view-lifecycle
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual control-object core pin/unpin/hidden/clear/restore journal, quota and partial failure; RTT/GPU primitives are models

checks.name: control-table-permissions
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual cold/runtime CPU table helpers with host RO enforcement; physical EL2/MMU/cache/TLB primitives modeled

checks.name: as-root-checks
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual split root equality/fresh implemented-AS mask, independent values/bitmaps and compiled mutants; MMIO modeled

checks.name: diagnostic-routing
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual merged status arm/FW service auth/mapping-lock wrapper with explicit endpoint/device doubles; counters never execution/completion authority

checks.name: irq-view
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual Root/RMM bridge and current RAW/mask helper over independent noncoherent cache worlds, 48 scenarios and14 compiled mutants; cache/MMIO/GIC/physical IRQ are models, separate from board provenance evidence

checks.name: client-local-irq-work
checks.evidence_boundary: Actual kernel IRQ-work/chain state-machine and compiled mutant models only; no new matrix or physical-security coverage claim.

checks.name: c-source-contract
checks.evidence_boundary: Formatting-independent checker mutation/extraction contracts only; no GPU attack evidence.

checks.name: lab-postflight-contract
checks.evidence_boundary: Control-host recovery-state expectations only; no runtime GPU policy evidence.
